segments.text: WHen I was in trouble, I called vpon the Lorde and he hearde me.
Deliuer my ſoule, O Lorde, from lying lyppes: and from a deceyptfull tongue.
What rewarde ſhalbe geuen vnto thee, thou falſe tongue? euen mightie and ſharpe arowes, with hote burning coales.
Woe is me that I am conſtrained to dwel with Meſech: and to haue myne habitacion among the tentes of Cedar.
My ſoule hath long dwelt among them: that bee enemies vnto peace.
I labour for peace, but when I ſpeake vnto them therof: they make them to battayle.
As it was in the beginning. &c. Amen.
